summary: Memory-chip complex broke on a KOSPI -10% leveraged-ETF unwind (SK Hynix/Samsung -12%), cascading into US semis: SOXX -7.88%, MU -13.18%, SNDK -13.64%. VIX +12.79%. But SPX -1.44% with positive breadth (adv 284 > dec 215) and defensive leadership (XLP +1.87%, XLV +1.41%, IBM/MRK/JNJ +3%) = rotation, not capitulation. Micron earnings Wed 24 June AH is the pivot.
